description.text: Grants [Twin Element Mode (Fire, Wind)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Faris], [Sea Sovereign Ability Tracker] and [Sea Sovereign Level]

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Fire, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Wind] after using a Fire/Wind ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Faris
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Sea Sovereign (0~2), removed after using Sea Sovereign two times

description.name: Sea Sovereign Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Sea Sovereign level by 1 after using 7 Wind or Fire abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Faris]

description.name: Sea Sovereign Level
description.text: Keeps track of Sea Sovereign level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Faris]
